+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+Final verification script to demonstrate the fix for empty set as_string() method.
+"""
+import astroid
+from astroid.nodes.node_classes import Set
+
+print("=== Empty Set Fix Verification ===")
+
+# Test 1: Programmatically created empty set
+print("\n1. Testing programmatically created empty set:")
+empty_set = Set(lineno=0, col_offset=0, end_lineno=0, end_col_offset=0, parent=None)
+empty_set.postinit(elts=[])
+result = empty_set.as_string()
+print(f"   Empty set as_string(): '{result}'")
+assert result == "set()", f"FAIL: Expected 'set()', got '{result}'"
+print("   ✓ PASS: Empty set correctly returns 'set()'")
+
+# Test 2: Programmatically created non-empty set

+non_empty_set = Set(lineno=0, col_offset=0, end_lineno=0, end_col_offset=0, parent=None)

+result = non_empty_set.as_string()
+print(f"   Single element set as_string(): '{result}'")
+assert result == "{1}", f"FAIL: Expected '{{1}}', got '{result}'"
+print("   ✓ PASS: Non-empty set correctly returns '{1}'")
+
+# Test 3: Parsing set() expression
+print("\n3. Testing parsed set() expression:")
+parsed_set = astroid.extract_node("set()")
+result = parsed_set.as_string()
+print(f"   Parsed set() as_string(): '{result}'")
+assert result == "set()", f"FAIL: Expected 'set()', got '{result}'"
+print("   ✓ PASS: Parsed set() correctly returns 'set()'")

+print(f"   Parsed {{1}} as_string(): '{result}'")

+def test_arguments_contains_all():
+    """Ensure Arguments.arguments actually returns all available arguments"""
+
+    def manually_get_args(arg_node) -> set:
+        names = set()
+        if arg_node.args.vararg:
+            names.add(arg_node.args.vararg)
+        if arg_node.args.kwarg:
+            names.add(arg_node.args.kwarg)
+
+        names.update([x.name for x in arg_node.args.args])
+        names.update([x.name for x in arg_node.args.kwonlyargs])
+
+        return names
+
+    node = extract_node("""def a(fruit: str, *args, b=None, c=None, **kwargs): ...""")
+    assert manually_get_args(node) == {x.name for x in node.args.arguments}
+
+    node = extract_node("""def a(mango: int, b="banana", c=None, **kwargs): ...""")
+    assert manually_get_args(node) == {x.name for x in node.args.arguments}
+
+    node = extract_node("""def a(self, num = 10, *args): ...""")
+    assert manually_get_args(node) == {x.name for x in node.args.arguments}
